properties.project_name: Mission Creek Park -- east reach (Pavilion to 4th St bridge)
properties.digitized_from: Hand-traced from satellite imagery (Esri World Imagery), step by step, rather than from a placement transferred from the plan PDF, which repeatedly mis-located this segment.
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-19: fills the gap between the already-tracked Mission Creek Park (which stops at its own NE corner near 235 Berry St/the 4th St bridge) and the already-tracked Mission Creek Park Pavilion further east -- OCII's plan labels P1 and P3 both fall in this stretch (per the neighboring records' own p_number notes, sourced from OCII's Nov 2024 CAC 'Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update'; which built segment is P1 vs P3 is not resolved by that source and is not resolved here either). The owner corrected three successive attempts at locating and sizing this by satellite-derived pixel transform alone (which is exactly the failure mode this project's own header notes already warn about) before switching to owner-guided tracing: first a wrong area entirely (a bad 2-point transform), then a too-narrow shoreline-path-only trace, then a too-wide trace that ate into the paved road on the south side. Final shape: the full visible landscaped extent from the Pavilion to the 4th St bridge, at the width the owner confirmed, trimmed to exclude the Pavilion's own already-tracked footprint (400 sqm overlap removed). Checked against src/street_geometry.py's real street buffer: 0% clipped -- this stretch corresponds to a 'paper' (platted but never built) segment of Channel St, per src/street_geometry.py's own NOT_YET_REAL_CENTERLINE_LAYERS filter, consistent with it being built out as park instead of road. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: correction to the P1/P3 statement above: on page 2 of the cited OCII Nov 2024 deck, the 'MISSION CREEK PARK P1' label points at the south-bank strip up to the 4th St bridge and 'MISSION CREEK PARK P3' at the wider green east of 4th St toward 3rd St/China Basin, so the source does resolve it: the traced stretch (Pavilion to the 4th St bridge, south bank) is P1, and P3 lies outside it. p_number and notes were corrected to say so; the file name and record id keep 'p1_p3' for now (a rename is left for the owner). project_name's extent wording ('east reach (Pavilion to 4th St bridge)') is our own description of the trace, not from a source. OCII's open-space page lists 'P1 Amphitheater at Mission Creek Park' and 'P3 Mission Creek Park' and is now cited. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from, notes reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- hand-traced from satellite imagery with the owner's direct, iterative guidance (not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team, and not derived from the PDF-pixel transform, which was unreliable for this specific stretch). Status 'complete' because landscaping (paths, trees and grass) is visible on the strip in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29) and in the earlier Esri imagery; the cited OCII deck shows 'Mission Creek Park (P3)' as a photo slide with no status text, and no cited source dates or confirms completion of P1.'; digitized_from: 'Hand-traced from satellite imagery (contextily/Esri World Imagery), guided step-by-step by the owner (who knows this stretch directly) rather than the PDF-pixel transform, which repeatedly mis-located this segment.'; notes: 'OCII plan label P1 (see p_number); an earlier version of this note said the record covers P1 and P3 combined, which the Nov 2024 map does not support. OCII's open-space page lists 'P1 Amphitheater at Mission Creek Park' and 'P3 Mission Creek Park'.'. CORRECTED 2026-10-10 (boundary with P2; no other change to the shape): the owner pointed out that the striped crosswalk beside the Mission Creek Park Pavilion is the natural hand-off between this stretch (P1) and P2, and asked that the crosswalk itself belong to this shape. The shape is now cut by a straight line across the park, perpendicular to the creek's long axis, through the south-west end of the crosswalk's stripes as seen in Esri World Imagery (viewed 2026-10-10); everything south-west of that line (about 3,800 m2, including a ~220 m2 overlap with P2 that the notes above flagged as unreconciled) was removed from this shape and is now P2's. The north-east side is unchanged. CORRECTED 2026-10-11 (figures only; no change to the shape): the 2026-10-10 entry above gives the overlap with P2 as '~220 m2' and the strip moved as 'about 3,800 m2'. Recomputed from the committed shapes (the files at the commit before b422c6f7 against the files after it; both outlines projected to UTM zone 10N, EPSG:32610, areas by shapely): the old east reach (14,296 m2) and the old P2 (11,630 m2) overlapped by 1,222 m2, not ~220 m2. The east reach lost 3,739 m2 (to 10,556 m2) and gained nothing; P2 lost nothing (under 0.01 m2) and gained 2,517 m2 (to 14,147 m2), which is the 3,739 m2 moved less the 1,222 m2 P2 already covered. The two new shapes share no area. So 'about 3,800 m2' above should read about 3,700 m2 (3,739 m2), and the overlap with P2 within it was 1,222 m2, not ~220 m2. Earlier entries above are unedited.
properties.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- hand-traced from satellite imagery (not a surveyed footprint or GIS file from the project team, and not derived from a placement transferred from the plan PDF, which was unreliable for this specific stretch). Status 'complete' because landscaping (paths, trees and grass) is visible on the strip in USDA NAIP imagery (viewed 2026-09-29) and in the earlier Esri imagery; the cited OCII deck shows 'Mission Creek Park (P3)' as a photo slide with no status text, and no cited source dates or confirms completion of P1.
properties.notes: OCII plan label P1; an earlier version of this note said the record covers P1 and P3 combined, which the Nov 2024 map does not support. OCII's open-space page lists 'P1 Amphitheater at Mission Creek Park' and 'P3 Mission Creek Park'.
properties.p_number: P1, per page 2 of OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update ('Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update'), whose 'MISSION CREEK PARK P1' label points at this south-bank stretch up to the 4th St bridge; its 'MISSION CREEK PARK P3' label is on the wider green east of 4th St, outside this trace. (Earlier text said P1 and P3, unresolved; that was not what the source shows.)
